facts.text:
Before this keyholder can start, its ServiceAccount farcast-system/datasphered needs read/write access to the bucket, granted to it by its uid. In Cloud Shell, run:
  gcloud storage buckets add-iam-policy-binding 'gs://farcast-atlas-5f3a9c21' --member 'principal://iam.googleapis.com/projects/123456789012/locations/global/workloadIdentityPools/proj-atlas.svc.id.goog/kubernetes.serviceaccount.uid/00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000000d5' --role 'roles/storage.objectAdmin' --condition=None
  gcloud storage buckets add-iam-policy-binding 'gs://farcast-atlas-5f3a9c21' --member 'principal://iam.googleapis.com/projects/123456789012/locations/global/workloadIdentityPools/proj-atlas.svc.id.goog/kubernetes.serviceaccount.uid/00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000000d5' --role 'roles/storage.legacyBucketReader' --condition=None
Then wait for IAM (typically 2 minutes, up to 7 or more), and remove the binding every FarCast instance in project 'proj-atlas' shares:
  gcloud storage buckets remove-iam-policy-binding 'gs://farcast-atlas-5f3a9c21' --member 'principal://iam.googleapis.com/projects/123456789012/locations/global/workloadIdentityPools/proj-atlas.svc.id.goog/subject/ns/farcast-system/sa/datasphered' --role 'roles/storage.objectAdmin' --condition=None
  gcloud storage buckets remove-iam-policy-binding 'gs://farcast-atlas-5f3a9c21' --member 'principal://iam.googleapis.com/projects/123456789012/locations/global/workloadIdentityPools/proj-atlas.svc.id.goog/subject/ns/farcast-system/sa/datasphered' --role 'roles/storage.legacyBucketReader' --condition=None
The grant is on the BUCKET, not the project, and object access is
separated from bucket reads so the keyholder cannot delete its own bucket.
A plan made before this grant cannot be confirmed after it.
